name: pulse-audio-addon
description: CoreAudio AudioUnit addon for the Pulse Dialer SIP daemon: opens the microphone and speaker and exchanges 8 kHz mono Int16 frames with desktop/daemon/lib/audio/coreaudio.js. Built on macOS only; the daemon degrades to the silent 'null' backend elsewhere.
//why-this-file-exists: desktop/scripts/build-daemon.sh runs `npm install` and `npm run build` in this directory. Without a manifest both commands fail, the addon is never produced, and the daemon silently falls back to the null backend — a call that connects and carries no audio in either direction. binding.gyp also resolves its include directory with `require('node-addon-api').include_dir`, so node-addon-api has to be installed here for the build to configure at all.
//platform: macOS with Xcode command line tools (xcode-select --install). On any other OS `node-gyp rebuild` will fail; that is expected, and build-daemon.sh sets --skip-addon automatically when uname is not Darwin.
